answer: To blunt sybil floods, every new agent must enter through a single bonded jetty: a narrow on-ramp that accepts only one stake-backed enrollment per hardware-attested key. The stake starts as a dim ember of credit, spendable only after the agent has countersigned a quorum of real peer work. A public prism then fans each claimant's attestations by time, peer set, and stake lineage, so sockpuppets that share one operator collapse into one band and forfeit the bond before they can vote or mine at full weight.
